column2: [intro]
At the sports club, a rendezvous,
Under the neon lights, we get on our knees,
The balls zoom, like owls in flight,
We play squash, it’s the taste of delight.
Swing, swing your squash,
On the court, the rallies are a splash,
The racket spins, it’s a clash,
Swing, swing your squash, don’t lose the flash!
I jump, I glide, I’m like a tiger,
The net is a challenge, I deliver,
Opponents tremble, they sweat,
I dominate the court, it’s a riot.
Swing, swing your squash,
On the court, the rallies are a splash,
The racket spins, it’s a clash,
Swing, swing your squash, don’t lose the flash!
[ solo ]
So go ahead, dance your squash,
Have fun, make the ground vibrate with a crash,
For nothing beats a good game of hit and play,
Swing your squash, to always have a blast!
[outro]
